title: Notice regarding Virtual Conduct of court proceedings by the Hon'ble Court.
text:
KEY LINES:
Read :- Notice No. HCG-01/2025, dated 05/05/2025.
Date: - 02/07/2025

FULL TEXT:
Read :- Notice No. HCG-01/2025, dated 05/05/2025.
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 02/07/2025
N O T I C E
HCG-03/2025
In Continuation of the Notice mentioned in the
Preamble; It is hereby notified for the information of all
concerned that, Hon’ble Mr. Justice Umesh A. Trivedi
would continue to conduct the Court Proceedings virtually
from the official residence of His Lordship.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
